name: webmcp-profiler
description: Drop-in performance analyser for WebMCP tool surfaces: per-call spans, payload and token accounting, host-gap ledger, live overlay, an agent-readable report tool, and an agentless bench. Zero dependencies.
author: Luca Guglielmi

scripts.build: vite build && vite build -c vite.iife.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.bench.json
scripts.diagrams: d2 --layout=dagre --theme=4 --pad=36 diagrams/architecture.d2 diagrams/architecture.svg && d2 --layout=dagre --theme=4 --pad=36 diagrams/evidence-loop.d2 diagrams/evidence-loop.svg && d2 --layout=dagre --theme=4 --pad=36 diagrams/host-gap.d2 diagrams/host-gap.svg && d2 --layout=dagre --theme=4 --pad=36 diagrams/interception.d2 diagrams/interception.svg && d2 --layout=dagre --theme=4 --pad=36 diagrams/latency-split.d2 diagrams/latency-split.svg && d2 --layout=dagre --theme=4 --pad=36 diagrams/relay.d2 diagrams/relay.svg && d2 --layout=dagre --theme=4 --pad=36 diagrams/span-lifecycle.d2 diagrams/span-lifecycle.svg && npm run page
scripts.prepublishOnly: node scripts/prepublish-check.mjs && npm run build && publint && npm run docs:check && npm run size
